description: Use this when a Phorme coach wants their AI coach to know something they teach: a cue, a drill, how they see a movement, a transcript of them explaining it. It adds it, in the coach's own words, to what their coach teaches from. Never invent or rewrite the coach's meaning. Set confirmation to true only after the coach said to add it.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

confirmation.description: True only after the coach said to add this.

text.description: What the coach teaches, in their own words.

title.description: A short name for it, for example "How I cue the hinge".

name: teach_my_coach
title: Teach my coach
